caption:
“Don’t do these things if you have ADHD “ - Yang Mun 

#adhd #usahealth #wellness #newyork #adhdtips
transcript: Here are things you must not do if your mind carries the wind of ADHD. First, do not stay up late. When the night steals your sleep, your mind becomes scattered like leaves in a storm. Do not live only in the moment without looking even one step ahead. A river flows smoothly because it knows its direction. A mind without direction becomes restless. Be careful with caffeine. It gives strength for a short moment, but in time it drains your inner energy and makes the mind even more unsettled. And the last, very important one, do not pour your fire onto others. Do not start fights. A heated heart blinds the mind and steals peace from your spirit. Start gently with yourself and your mind will begin to follow.
